member.name: T:Api.Security.StyleNonce
member.summary:
The CSP style nonce for a browser.
A fresh nonce on every response changes the HTML body on every request, and a scanner comparing two responses for the same page (ZAP rule 10104, User Agent Fuzzer) then reports every page. So the nonce is derived from a random per-browser seed held in an HttpOnly cookie, keyed with a secret that never leaves the process. The same browser gets the same shell; another browser, or the same one after the cookie expires, gets a different nonce. A page cannot read the seed, and the nonce itself is hidden from CSS and the DOM.

member.summary: Host-only, Secure, HttpOnly cookie carrying the per-browser seed.

member.name: F:Api.Security.StyleNonce.SeedLifetime
member.summary: The seed is rotated by expiry, which also rotates the nonce.

member.summary: A process-local key: every response from this process uses it.
